description: Russia's official company and sole-trader register (EGRUL/EGRIP, Federal Tax Service): search by INN, OGRN/OGRNIP or name (Cyrillic). Returns short and full name, kind (legal entity or individual entrepreneur), INN, OGRN, KPP, registration date, termination date if closed, head of the company (title and name), region, and the total number of matches. 20 records per page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: INN (10 or 12 digits), OGRN (13) / OGRNIP (15), or a company / person name in Russian, e.g. 7707083893 or СБЕРБАНК

region.description: Optional 2-digit region code to narrow a name search, e.g. 77 (Moscow), 78 (St Petersburg), 50 (Moscow oblast)
